welcome.title: Welcome — thank you for reviewing this translation!
welcome.howTo: How it works: on the right you see the machine translation, on the left the original text. Go through the segments and tick the checkbox when the translation is correct — or click into the text to correct it directly. Use the filters at the top to focus on shortened segments or segments that need review. When everything is correct, click “Approve translation” at the top — only then is the review complete.
welcome.glossaryHint: Words with a dotted cyan line are company terminology from the glossary — please leave them unchanged if possible.
welcome.shortcuts: Keyboard tips: J/K next/previous segment · Space mark as checked + next · E edit · ? ask a question

placeholder.title: Placeholder text detected — {{found}} of {{total}} segments
placeholder.bodyLorem: The source file contains classic Lorem Ipsum. The typesetter may have forgotten to replace the placeholder with real text. Translations of these segments are unusable — check the source file before export.
placeholder.bodyIndesign: The source file contains InDesign placeholder text (Adobe Latin). The typesetter may have forgotten to replace the placeholder with real text. Translations of these segments are unusable — check the source file before export.

tooltip.checkedByAt: Checked by {{name}} on {{date}} — click to undo
tooltip.markChecked: Mark as checked · Shift+click for a range
tooltip.showDiff: Show changes compared to the original translation
tooltip.condensed: Shortened automatically to fit the layout frame
tooltip.glossaryTerms: Contains terms from the company glossary
tooltip.clarificationAsk: Ask a question — if something is unclear
tooltip.quickadd: Add selected text to the glossary

clarificationDialog.title: Ask a question
clarificationDialog.intro: Segment #{{num}} will be marked with “❓ Question”. Your note helps the requester clarify the translation precisely — instead of guessing.
clarificationDialog.notePlaceholder: e.g. Does “strip” mean an LED light strip here, or just a stripe?

downloadWarning.title: Translation not approved
downloadWarning.body: No native speaker has confirmed this translation — or an earlier approval was cancelled by a later change. The file may contain errors.
downloadWarning.ack: I understand that this translation is not approved.

quickadd.title: Add term to glossary
quickadd.syncHint: will be synchronised with DeepL automatically on the next run

result.unchanged: The term was already in the glossary unchanged.
result.vorschlag: Proposal submitted, an admin will approve it.

toast.bulkApproveFailed: Could not mark the segments as checked

release.mailFailures: Approved, but the notification to {{names}} could not be sent.

revokeReason.unapproved: check mark removed from a segment

release.buttonTitle: Confirm that the translation is correct
release.buttonTitleBlocked: First check all segments and resolve all questions
release.confirmText_one: You confirm that the segment is correct.
release.confirmText_few: You confirm that all {{count}} segments are correct.
release.confirmText_many: You confirm that all {{count}} segments are correct.
release.confirmText_other: You confirm that all {{count}} segments are correct.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.clarification: Ask a question about the active segment
shortcuts.nextReview: Jump to the next segment that needs review
shortcuts.bonus: Tip: Shift+click on a checkbox marks the whole range since the last checkbox you clicked.

request.title: Ask native speakers for a review
request.intro: Each selected person receives an email with a link to the review page and signs in with their Microsoft account. One approval is enough — the others are then informed that it is done.
request.speakersLabel: Native speakers (language {{lang}}) — one or more people
request.messagePlaceholder: e.g. “I need it by Friday, thanks!”

filter.bulkApproveTitle_other: Mark all {{count}} currently visible segments as checked
